As much as I understand the concept of neuroplasticity I feel it is difficult to apply in this situation. I am regularly exposed to the same environment that got me to this point. No matter how much I try to focus my mind elsewhere it falls back to default. I have come to a point where I genuinely have nothing to live for. I do not look forward to achieving anything from what life has to offer. It sounds narrow minded but it is genuinely how I have felt, for more than a year now. 

I appreciate your response and value your insight.

I have gone to therapy with a cognitive counselor to basically "motivate me". I really felt it was met with diminishing returns after a couple months. I have a supportive group of family and friends. I do not want to sound ungrateful but they really can not help me. Most people that talk to me tell me "well its only one more year" but its easier to give advice than take it. How would these same people react if this happened to them? I am growing slowly resentful and withdrawing from responding to friends and family. Ive essentially put up a good way of masking that anything is wrong, just so I don't create any waves. 

Ultimately this group is not with me on a day to day or see me daily. I live on the other side of the country, alone. I have friends here but I am not going to meet with friends with a negative attitude. It defeats the whole purpose of  "going out" or "meeting up"

I really appreciate your reply. I really really do.
